title: Regulation 9028 — Regulation on Microgrid Development
authority: Puerto Rico Energy Bureau (Negociado de Energía; formerly Puerto Rico Energy Commission)
notes: The adopted Regulation 9028 PDF on energia.pr.gov is a scanned image (no text layer). Section-level controlling language is quoted from the Energy Commission's published text of the regulation in CEPR-MI-2018-0001 (quote_source_url). Section numbering and thresholds must be confirmed against the adopted text by an energy-regulatory expert. PREB opened an informal review of Regulation 9028 on 2023-10-11; no adopted replacement was located. PREB's draft Distributed Generation and Microgrid Interconnection Regulation (NEPR-MI-2019-0009) may change microgrid interconnection.

notes: The Department of State PDF is a scanned image (no text layer), so no controlling language is quoted from it directly.
